bonuses.name: Express Line
bonuses.text: With 2 railroads: instead of rolling, pay $50 to the bank and move to any railroad you own. Then roll 1 die and move that many spaces. You may Nudge. Express Line never gives an extra turn.

bonuses.name: Toll Collector
bonuses.text: With 3 railroads: gain 1 Momentum token every time someone pays you railroad rent.

bonuses.name: Rail Baron
bonuses.text: With all 4 railroads: your Precision Rolls cost 1 token instead of 2.

bonuses.name: Utility Bill
bonuses.text: With both utilities: every time an opponent passes GO, they pay you $20 out of their salary.

bonuses.name: Power Grid
bonuses.text: With both utilities: every time an opponent builds a level, they pay you $10.
